column2: Where have some settings gone (order of lists, of charts, widget library, language, DNA)?
column3: They are now where you use them. The order of the lists: Lists → “Reorder” (a window). The order of diagrams and statistics: Charts → “⠿ Reorder the charts” (under the colours). The widget library: Dashboard → “🧩 Widget library”; the widgets in place: “Reorder the widgets” and the ✎ of each widget. The language, the default calendar and the player: Settings → “Theme and colours”, after “Displayed name”. The DNA display: DNA → ⚙️ Settings. The order of the Settings pages: “Reorder” at the bottom of the Settings column.

column2: Where do I set the tree boxes (white, male / female colours, with photo, mini)?
column3: In Charts → “🎨 Colours of stats and trees” (at the bottom of the left column), “🌳 Tree boxes” section: choose a card (the preview shows a real tree with your data), then the width of the boxes, the lines, the dates and the Sosa badge. Just below, “Colours by sex” brings everything together: the colour of each sex (bands and pale background of the “Male / female colours” boxes, and round portraits) and the background and text of the “White” boxes. Everything is kept with “Save”. These boxes used to be in Designs to choose from: your choices are carried over as they were.

column2: Where have the “Ready-made sets”, the font and the dashboard of the designs to choose from gone?
column3: They have been removed: they duplicated Appearance and sometimes stopped it working (for example, with “Old archives”, changing the font or the Preset no longer did anything). The font and text size are chosen in Appearance (“Font”, “Text size”); for an archive atmosphere, take the “Paper archive” Preset in Appearance and, if you like, “Old paper” in Designs to choose from → A1. The dashboard stays as before (widths 1, ½, ⅓…). Your old choices are cleaned up by themselves: the rest of your designs is kept (Movements becomes A7, Lists A8).

column2: Why are some settings switches and others checkboxes?
column3: A switch (the little button that slides) changes what you see straight away: it is a setting, kept by itself. A checkbox is for choosing items in a list, or an option that only counts when you click the button (“Save”, “Create”, “⤓ Export”…).

column2: How do I write a time or a duration?
column3: As you would say it: “14 h 30”, “14:30”, “9h05” or “noon” for a time; “2 h 15”, “1 min 30”, “90 s” or “1:30” for a duration. Just below, the app writes what it understood (“✓ Understood: 1 min 30 s”) or warns you (“⚠️ Impossible time”). For numbers, the unit (px, mm, cm, %, s…) is written inside the box, on the right.

column2: Do the designs to choose from change my Accessibility or Appearance settings?
column3: No. The first frame of Appearance (Preset, Main colour, Font, Text size, Tab menu…) always comes first: a design only changes the shape (lines, shadows, corners, density, icons, record header, tree boxes, buttons, lists, movements), never the font, the text size or the colours. The colour of the record lines follows the colours of your Preset; a theme of your own that has its own lines (✎ My themes) keeps them. Accessibility also keeps priority: if “Reduce animations” is ticked, nothing moves, whatever the movements. The male / female colours of the tree boxes are the same as those of the portraits (Appearance → 👤 Portraits): changing them in one place changes them in the other.

column2: How do I arrange or hide the shapes offered?
column3: Settings → “Portraits and avatars” → “1 · The shape” → “⚙️ Manage the shapes”: untick a shape to hide it from the row, drag ⠿ (or ↑ ↓) to arrange it, then “Save the order and the shapes shown”. Your own shapes can be edited, duplicated, exported and deleted (with “↶ Undo”). “↺ Reset to default” puts back the original order and shows all the shapes.

column2: How do I hide the big frame at the top of a record (for a slideshow)?
column3: Settings → “Person and animal records” → “Record header” → Frame: “Hide the whole frame” (kept straight away). Records then start with the parents, spouses and children, then the blocks. To put it back: same place, “Show the frame”.

column2: How do I hide or arrange the buttons at the top right (split screen, new window, 🔒, 🧓, 🧮, My genealogies)?
column3: Settings → Appearance → “Buttons at the top right”: untick a button to hide it, drag its handle ⠿ (or Alt + ↑ / ↓) to change the order; it is kept straight away (“↶ Undo” at the bottom left), and the preview shows the top bar. “↺ Reset to default” puts back the app’s order, with all the buttons except 🧓 (hidden at first). The 🧮 and 🧓 buttons also follow their own switches (calculator settings; Settings → Accessibility → 🧓 Simple mode): it is the same setting. Kept with the 💾 Saved settings of Appearance and the site defaults.

column2: How do I arrange the square buttons at the top of a record, or put them in 2 columns?
column3: Settings → “Person and animal records” → “Record header”: drag the buttons (✨ life story, 👁＋ new observation (animal records), 🔖 bookmark, 🗑 delete, 🔓 lock, 🕘 history, 🧩 This person was…, hidden at first: tick it to show it) or use ↑ ↓, untick those to hide, choose “In 2 columns” if you like: it is kept straight away (“✓ Saved”, “↶ Undo”). The preview shows the result. It is kept in the “💾 Saved settings”.

column2: Where do I put the “🧩 This person was…” link at the top of the record?
column3: Settings → “Person and animal records” → “Record header” → “🧩 This person was…” link: a square 🧩 button in the column of buttons, or at the bottom of the column of badges (under To check, Outside the genealogy, Artist). It is hidden at first: tick 🧩 in the list of buttons to show it (untick it to hide it again). A click opens the person’s profiles page (or the choice of their profiles if they have none yet). Not on animal records.

column2: How do I add a birthday to my calendar (phone, Google, Apple, Outlook)?
column3: On an event of the record, click 📅: every year or just once, with a reminder the day before. For the whole family: Lists → Family calendar → “⤓ Export the birthdays (.ics)” (direct ancestors, the whole database, a branch, living only). Open the file to add it; importing it again creates no duplicate. Approximate dates or dates reduced to the year cannot go into a calendar.

column2: How do I restore an old photo in one go?
column3: Retouch → 🧭 Restore tab (or Image) → “✨ Restore in one go”. Tick the steps (denoising, dust, creases, contrast, sharpness, colourisation) while looking at their previews, set the strength, then “Apply”. Each step becomes a “✨” layer that you can hide or adjust; ↶ undoes everything at once.

column2: How do I repair a crease or a tear on a photo?
column3: 🪡 Repair tool (R key): paint over the crease and it is rebuilt from what surrounds it. “🔍 Find the creases” finds the fine lines and shows them to you in red before filling them in (to check: it can also mark real lines).

column2: How do I compare before and after a retouch?
column3: Under the photo, “◧ Curtain”: drag the line, ⇅ changes the direction. ⤓ Export → Before / after saves a side-by-side or curtain image, with a caption.

column2: How do I make portraits in the same format?
column3: Retouch → Image → “🪪 Crop as an ID photo”: the eyes are made horizontal, at the same height, in 3:4; “Use as portrait” sends it to the record. For several records: Editing tools → Retouch → “🪪 ID portraits”.

column2: How do I see my projects as large thumbnails?
column3: Lists → Editing tools: next to “Sort”, choose “Cards” (one card per project) or “List” (the table). The choice is kept for each tool.

column2: How do I see a list as cards rather than rows?
column3: Above each list, just before “Sort”, click “List” (one row per item: small image, name, details, date) or “Cards” (one card per item with a large image). Each list remembers your choice and your sorting: Boards can stay as cards and People as a list.

column2: Can I sort the cards like the table?
column3: Yes: in “Cards” mode, the “Sort” menu arranges the cards like the columns of the table (by name, by date…).

column2: How do I change the big buttons of simple mode?
column3: Settings → Accessibility → “🧓 Simple mode” tab → 06 “What is shown” → “The big buttons”. For each tile: ⠿ or ↑ ↓ to arrange it, the switch to show or hide it, ✎ to change its name, its short sentence, its icon and its colour (↺ resets the tile to default). “＋ Add a tile”: ⭐ A person (opens their record in sentences), 📸 An album (its photos as a slideshow) or 💌 A note from the family (a text in large print, read aloud with 🔊); ⧉ to make another one the same, × to remove it. Just below, “Layout”: how many per row (1 to 4), height, spacing, title size and font of the tiles. Everything is kept in the “💾 Saved settings” of simple mode.

column2: How do I show the tree to an elderly person (simple mode)?
column3: “🧓 Simple mode”: very big buttons (🌳 The tree, 📷 The photos, 👥 The people, 🎂 On this day), sentences read aloud and nothing that can be changed or deleted. Open it with the “🧓 Simple mode” button at the top of the app (hidden at first: tick “Show the button…” at the very top of the “🧓 Simple mode” tab), the dashboard widget or Settings → Accessibility → “🧓 Simple mode” tab → “▶ Open simple mode”. The first time, the app first shows you its settings. So that a tablet always opens on it: “Open the app directly in simple mode” (on this device), or the address …/#mode-simple.

column2: How do I leave simple mode?
column3: On the home screen only: keep your finger pressed on “🔒 Leave simple mode” (3 seconds at first, adjustable), or hold the Enter key down. If a 4-digit code has been chosen, the app then asks for it. The code is kept hidden (hashed), never in plain text; it is not real protection, it only avoids leaving by mistake. Esc only does “Back”.

column2: How do I set up simple mode (who is watching, colours, size, voice)?
column3: Settings → Accessibility → “🧓 Simple mode” tab. Eight sections with their “Why?”: who is watching (to write “your mother”, “your great-grandson”), colours (the contrast is checked live, “Fix” raises it to 7:1), sizes, font (Atkinson Hyperlegible, Luciole, OpenDyslexic…), voice, what is shown, slideshow and photo frame, exit. The preview on the right shows the tablet. Each change is kept straight away (“↶ Undo” at the bottom left); “Ready-made sets” applies everything at once, “💾 Saved settings” keeps, exports and imports your settings. Your “♿ Whole app” settings also apply here, unless you choose “Specific to simple mode”.
